# The Aureum Club

> A non-profit club in Amsterdam where founders, entrepreneurs and professionals
> meet: monthly after-work drinks, Sunday coffee meetups, seasonal private dinners
> and practical AI masterclasses. Women and men. Around 15 seats a night.

## What it is
The Aureum Club (joinaureum.com) is a curated, in-person community in Amsterdam,
founded by Maroussia Tyl (founder of WOGO Amsterdam) and Anna Kotcharyan (founder
of Pay the Public). It is a non-profit: ticket and membership income goes back into
the evenings (rooms, tables, food and drinks). 20+ evenings hosted since 2024.

## The formats and prices
- After-work drinks: monthly, one bar, intro round, small groups of 5 to 8. EUR 20 entrance, drinks at bar prices.
- Sunday coffee: 8 to 12 chairs at one table, intro round and a hot-seat question. EUR 20 per chair, coffee at own expense.
- Private dinner: one long table (about 15 seats) at a high-end Amsterdam restaurant, 3 courses and drinks. EUR 90.
- Masterclass: AI and practical skills taught by people who use them, followed by dinner.
Exact venues are shared after registration, never published in advance.

## Who it's for
Founders, entrepreneurs and professionals in Amsterdam, women and men, from first-year
founders to people running teams of fifty, freelancers and people planning their next
move. Not for collecting contacts or pitching from a stage.

## Membership
EUR 100 per year or EUR 20 per month, by application (form on https://joinaureum.com/membership.html).
Members reserve every evening before public sale at member price, get hot-seat sessions and
introductions on request. Non-members can attend any evening at the regular ticket price.

## Past venues
Capital C Diamantbeurs, Wolf Atelier, CELIA, The College Hotel, Satchmo, Dicky's Grand Cafe (all Amsterdam).

## Legal / non-profit status
Operates as a non-profit; registration as a Dutch stichting is in progress.

## Not to be confused with
The fashion brand "Aureum Club" (aureumclub.online) is unrelated. This is The Aureum Club, joinaureum.com, Amsterdam.
